scripts.dev: node scripts/require-free-port.mjs web server && pnpm validate:data && concurrently --names web,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @mirrorn/web dev" "pnpm --filter @mirrorn/server dev"
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/require-free-port.mjs web && pnpm validate:data && pnpm --filter @mirrorn/web dev
scripts.dev:server: node scripts/require-free-port.mjs server && pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @mirrorn/server dev
scripts.build: pnpm validate:data && pnpm --filter @mirrorn/server build && pnpm --filter @mirrorn/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @mirrorn/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @mirrorn/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @mirrorn/web typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @mirrorn/shared test && pnpm --filter @mirrorn/server test && pnpm --filter @mirrorn/web test
